newsitem.title: USA: Florida Power seeks fuel rate cuts.
newsitem.headline: Florida Power seeks fuel rate cuts.

text.p: Florida Power Corp said Wednesday it has asked the Florida Public Service Commission for approval to cut the fuel charge portion of its customers' bills beginning in October.
The company said it is seeking to reduce the fuel charge by $O.11 per 1,000 kilowatt hours.

When combined with a fuel charge reduction of $2.32 made in July, the utility company said residential customers will pay $2.43 less per 1,000 kilowatt hours than they paid in June. The cost of 1,000 kilowatt hours, beginning on October 1, will be $84.85.
The Public Service Commission is scheduled to vote on the request on August 14.
